hard: The figure is a schematic, not a full P&ID: controllers are not drawn as bubbles; the controller tag (FIC102, FIC101, FIC302, FIC301, PIC401, PIC501) is printed beside its valve, so each such valve carries the controller tag as its text; LVC502/LVC507 are valve tags.

In-line flowmeters (FT102, FT104, FT302, FT305, FT404, FT406), the ultrasonic sensor and the transparent pipeline section are keyed general; pressure taps B05-B20, PT*, LI* are keyed instrumentation with a kind-i edge to their tap point.

The drawing puts the mixing point at the top of the riser (j_mix joins the black mixed-flow line, the green air line and the blue water line); the mixed-flow loop through U39 and the horizontal pipeline is keyed as drawn.
Dashed control lines meter->valve run beside the pipe joining the same two symbols; in the graph they are one edge (the pipe); key.json also lists them in signal_edges.
The vertical line from PIC401 to FT404 crosses the riser-top line to the 2 phase separator with no join mark; keyed as a crossing (no junction).

uncertain.why: in-line flowmeters keyed general; counting them as instrumentation would score differently
the long dashed line from LI502 (3 phase separator) ends at LVC502 (coalescer outlet), as drawn
line ends with arrows to atmosphere (V10, V11, PIC501, compressor drain) are not keyed as inlet/outlet

consistency_check.method: same agent re-keyed, from fresh crops and without opening the key, every symbol whose centre lies in a seeded random 20% of a 5 x 4 cell grid (seed 20261029) and the links between those symbols; compared at IoU >= 0.5 with class. NOT independent: the same agent made the key and still had it in context.
consistency_check.note: the seeded cells fall mostly on empty paper or the legend: only 3 symbols and 1 link were in them, so this check says little
